name: 3dicons
summary: Library of 1,400+ hand-made 3D icon renders in multiple angles and colors, free under CC0 without attribution.
description: A set of hand-made 3D icons modelled in Blender and rendered at different angles and color options by Vijay Verma (@realvjy). Browse and download individual renders or the full V1 pack, use the Figma file and plugin, or edit color and angle online. Collections include V1, Halloween, Social and Christmas; released under CC0, so no attribution is required.
